purpose: Latest-only logical workspace pointers, upload staging and receipts, immutable content descriptors, bodies, pins, grants and lifecycle rows. One table makes pointer publication and file lifecycle one authority; prior objects remain private retention details rather than public versions.

serverSideEncryption.rationale: A dedicated file key separates customer bytes and file metadata from session execution state.

globalSecondaryIndexes.name: gsi_gc
globalSecondaryIndexes.rationale: One sparse index serves bounded mark and sweep over content descriptors and candidates; registry pointers and pins never enter it.

globalSecondaryIndexes.name: gsi_expiry
globalSecondaryIndexes.rationale: Download grants are spread over bounded due partitions; cleanup re-reads authority state and never trusts TTL timing.

stream.rationale: The worker receives pointer keys and performs an authoritative point read before network effects. KEYS_ONLY prevents inline content bodies or value documents from being duplicated into stream storage.

timeToLive.rationale: Grant pins, expired grants and replay receipts only. Uploads, pointers, descriptors and durable pins require explicit fenced cleanup.
